title: Evaluating the adhesion of human gingival fibroblasts and MG-63 osteoblast-like cells to activated PRP-coated membranes
authors: Vahabi S, Yadegary Z, Karamshahi M. 2019. Cell Tissue Bank. [Epub ahead of print].
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss Jason membrane (porcine pericardium) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “The results also showed that Jason® membrane had the highest amount of cell viability and adhesion” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
